proto_titration_002.document: Quantitative Acid-Base Neutralization Titration. Standardization of hydrochloric acid against sodium hydroxide with phenolphthalein indicator and pH probe tracking. ['Pipette 25.0 mL of 0.10 M HCl into the Erlenmeyer flask.', 'Add 3 drops of phenolphthalein indicator solution.', 'Position flask on magnetic stirrer and insert calibrated pH electrode.', 'Slowly dispense 0.10 M NaOH from burette while continuously monitoring pH.', 'Record the volume at the persistent pale pink equivalence endpoint (pH 7.0 - 8.2).', 'Compute analyte molarity using n_acid = n_base.'] Corrosive reagents. Wear nitrile protective gloves and chemical splash goggles.

proto_spectro_003.document: Verification of the Beer-Lambert Law via Optical Absorbance. Measurement of optical density and determination of molar absorptivity (epsilon) for aqueous copper(II) sulfate at 635 nm. ['Prepare five serial standard concentrations: 0.010, 0.025, 0.050, 0.075, 0.100 M CuSO4.', 'Zero the spectrophotometer using a deionized water blank cuvette at 635 nm.', 'Measure absorbance (A) and percentage transmittance (%T) for each standard solution.', 'Plot Absorbance versus Molar Concentration to construct the calibration curve.', 'Extract slope = ε · b to find molar extinction coefficient ε in L/(mol·cm).'] CuSO4 is an aquatic toxin and mild skin irritant. Collect all residues in designated heavy-metal waste vessel.

metadata.title: Verification of the Beer-Lambert Law via Optical Absorbance

proto_calorimetry_001.document: Determination of Specific Heat Capacity via Aqueous Calorimetry. Standard protocol for measuring the specific heat capacity (c) of liquid water using continuous Bunsen burner energy transfer and immersion thermocouple probe. ['Measure exactly 150.0 mL of deionized water using the graduated cylinder and transfer to the 250 mL beaker.', 'Record initial ambient liquid temperature T_initial (target 20.0°C to 25.0°C).', 'Light the Bunsen burner and adjust to non-luminous blue flame cone.', 'Place beaker on wire gauze directly above the flame.', 'Record thermocouple temperature at 5-second intervals until boiling plateau (100.0°C) is reached.', 'Calculate sensible heat absorbed using Q = m * c * ΔT.'] Wear ANSI Z87.1 splash goggles and heat-resistant silicone tongs. Do not heat dry glassware.

metadata.title: Determination of Specific Heat Capacity via Aqueous Calorimetry

proto_distill_004.document: Separation of Binary Mixture via Fractional Distillation. Separation of an ethanol-water binary mixture utilizing a Vigreux fractionating column with vapor temperature monitoring. ['Assemble fractional distillation apparatus ensuring all ground glass joints are lightly greased.', 'Charge round bottom flask with 50 mL ethanol and 50 mL water, adding 3 boiling chips.', 'Initiate counter-current cooling water through condenser jacket.', 'Gradually increase heating mantle voltage until gentle reflux begins in column.', 'Collect distillate when vapor temperature stabilizes at 78.3°C (ethanol boiling point).', 'Switch receiving flask when vapor temperature rises towards 100.0°C.'] Ethanol is highly flammable. Keep all open flames away from distillation apparatus. Ensure system is open to atmosphere.

metadata.title: Separation of Binary Mixture via Fractional Distillation

proto_kinetics_005.document: Kinetics of the Persulfate-Iodide Clock Reaction. Measurement of initial reaction rates and determination of rate law orders (m, n) for persulfate oxidation of iodide ions. ['Prepare Reaction Mixture A (KI + Na2S2O3 + starch + deionized water).', 'Prepare Reaction Mixture B ((NH4)2S2O8).', 'Combine solutions rapidly and initiate digital chronometer simultaneously.', 'Swirl continuously until instantaneous sudden transition to deep triiodide-starch blue.', 'Record elapsed time delta_t and compute reaction velocity rate = delta[S2O8^2-] / delta_t.', 'Vary concentrations to extract reaction order with respect to each reactant.'] Persulfate is an oxidizer. Avoid inhalation of dust and contact with organic reducing agents.

metadata.title: Kinetics of the Persulfate-Iodide Clock Reaction

proto_solubility_006.document: Determination of Solubility Product Constant (Ksp) of Calcium Hydroxide. Equilibrium titration of saturated aqueous Ca(OH)2 solution with standardized HCl to determine Ksp and Gibbs free energy delta G. ['Filter saturated Ca(OH)2 solution through fine filter paper discarding initial 5 mL.', 'Pipette 20.0 mL of clear filtrate into an Erlenmeyer flask.', 'Add 2 drops of methyl orange indicator.', 'Titrate with standardized 0.050 M HCl until color changes from yellow to orange-red.', 'Calculate [OH-] from volume of HCl titrant consumed.', 'Compute [Ca2+] = 0.5 * [OH-] and calculate Ksp = [Ca2+][OH-]^2.'] Calcium hydroxide is strongly basic and caustic to ocular tissues. Immediate flush required on accidental contact.

metadata.title: Determination of Solubility Product Constant (Ksp) of Calcium Hydroxide
